# Sefika Ozturk

> Sefika Ozturk works on AI safety: evaluations, reinforcement learning, and keeping autonomous agents accountable. Computer Science at Vanderbilt (Ingram Scholar). Leads the Vanderbilt AI Safety Initiative.

## Pages
- [Home](https://sefikaozturk.com/): who she is and what she's working on now
- [Projects](https://sefikaozturk.com/projects): things she has built
- [Writing](https://sefikaozturk.com/writing): policy memos and essays
- [The AUTONOMY Act](https://sefikaozturk.com/writing/autonomy-act): policy memo on liability for autonomous AI agents, with Rovier Chen
